# E0435: `when` in a lazy value's function

A `Lazy` computes its value whenever it is first asked for, so its function must not wait for shared values. Read them before, and capture the copy.

- Rule: [`polymorphism.lazy-waits-for-nothing`](../../reference/07-types.md#polymorphism.lazy-waits-for-nothing)
- Reported at: the `when`, or the call of a function that has `locks`, inside the function that `Lazy.new` keeps.
- Tier: `advanced`, checked in the `analyses` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0435:7
use std.sync
use std.lazy

type Rates = { euro: f64 }

fn priced(rates: sync.Shared<Rates>, amount: f64) -> lazy.Lazy<f64> {
  lazy.Lazy.new(|| when rates { amount * rates.euro })
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
use std.sync
use std.lazy

type Rates = { euro: f64 }

fn priced(rates: sync.Shared<Rates>, amount: f64) -> lazy.Lazy<f64> {
  let euro = when rates { rates.euro }
  lazy.Lazy.new(|| amount * euro)
}
```
